plugins.changelog: Avoids rewriting unchanged item metadata when rebuilding already-applied grouping. Keeps recovery capture ahead of actual grouping changes, and replaces private runtime cloning of Continue Watching queries with copies through public query/DTO properties. Adds repeat-apply and concurrent-query regressions. Includes bounded metadata reads, PostgreSQL Unicode/cache tests, Continue Watching deduplication and the settings layout fixes.
Initial catalog release: native scheduled synchronization of parental certifications and Parents Guide tags, with configurable dry runs and incremental state.

Translates the PostgreSQL dashboard, confirmation dialogs, errors, logs, health reports, migration output and documentation into English. Retains Jellyfin 12.4 compatibility, query-performance fixes, existing configuration and database state.
